_about: How each statewide body the ballot page lists seat by seat is elected: 'district' (each voter votes in the one seat for their district, so the page must help them find it) or 'statewide' (every voter votes for each seat; the seat is only a residency district or a numbered place). A constitutional or statutory fact per state and office, cited in _sources -- never inferred from a contest label, which reads the same either way ('Public Service Commission, District 3' is statewide-elected in Georgia and district-elected in Nebraska). An office missing here gets no such line. 'districts': 'congressional' says the body's districts are the state's congressional districts, so their counties come from county_district_crosswalk.json; other district bodies' places come from statewide_district_towns.json (scripts/fetch_statewide_district_towns.py) where the state publishes them.

_sources.GA public_service_commission: Elected statewide; a commissioner must reside in the district whose seat they hold (O.C.G.A. 46-2-1).
_sources.AL public_service_commission: Two associate commissioners, Place 1 and Place 2, elected statewide (Ala. Code 37-1-2).
_sources.AL state_board_of_education: Eight members elected from districts (Ala. Code 16-3-1).
_sources.CA board_of_equalization: Four members, each elected by the voters of one district (Cal. Const. art. XIII sec. 17).
_sources.CO state_board_of_education: One member elected from each congressional district, plus an at-large seat (Colo. Const. art. IX sec. 1); the at-large seat carries no district.
_sources.CO university_regent: One regent from each congressional district and the rest at large (Colo. Const. art. IX sec. 12); an at-large seat carries no district.
_sources.KS state_board_of_education: Ten members, one elected by each board district (Kan. Const. art. 6 sec. 2).
_sources.MA governors_council: Eight councillors, each chosen by the voters of one council district (Mass. Const. amend. art. 16).
_sources.NE public_service_commission: Five commissioners, each elected from a district (Neb. Rev. Stat. 75-101).
_sources.NE state_board_of_education: Eight members elected from districts (Neb. Const. art. VII sec. 3).
_sources.NE university_regent: Eight regents elected from districts (Neb. Const. art. VII sec. 10).
_sources.NH executive_council: Five councillors, each chosen by the voters of one district (N.H. Const. Pt. II Art. 60).
_sources.NM public_education_commission: Ten commissioners, each elected from a district (N.M. Const. art. XII sec. 6).
_sources.TX state_board_of_education: Fifteen members elected from districts (Tex. Educ. Code 7.103).
_sources.UT state_board_of_education: Fifteen members elected from districts (Utah Code 20A-14-101.5).
